overview: Hana is a bright young girl who lost her father at a young age. When her mother returns to Japan, she comes with her new Korean husband and his son Yunsuh. Yunsuh's mother died during his 10th birthday and after her death, he becomes autistic. While Hana is fond of her new step-brother, he wants nothing to do with her. When their parents leave on their honeymoon, Hana's mother leaves the children with her deceased husband's sister who will manage their inn during the trip. While they are gone, the aunt and her daughter Maya abuse Hana and make plans to sell the inn in order to pay for gambling debts and college. Despite all of this, Hana finds comfort in her brother who begins to open up to her and eventually speaks after his 20th Birthday and the day his mother passed away. Yunsuh's mother died on the same day as he was turning 10, 10 years ago. As they start to have feelings for...
title: Tree of Heaven

overview: Six-part English-language drama recalling the events of August 15, 2021, when the American troops withdrew from Afghanistan, through the eyes of an Afghani family. As American troops withdraw, the Taliban enter Kabul. The Nazany family is forced to flee the country, like many civilians, for fear of reprisals. In this desperate and chaotic situation, looming over by the threat of an attack by the Islamic State, French police, Italian diplomats, German military personnel, and American intelligence services must somehow coordinate to manage the influx of civilians. How will each of them manage to save their lives? The countdown has begun.
title: Kabul

overview: The career of Alain Prost, four-time Formula 1 world champion and winner of 51 races, undoubtedly the greatest and best French racing driver in the history of F1.
title: Prost

overview: The second and concluding programme in Diarmuid Gavin's global journey to find out where we came from...
title: Blood of the Irish

overview: 7News presents a ground-breaking true crime series revealing new evidence that Australia's most notorious serial killer may have been responsible for more murders beyond the Belanglo Seven.
title: Ivan Milat: Buried Secrets

overview: Liam Neeson narrates this two-part documentary marking the 175th anniversary of The famine, exploring the international origins, development and legacy.
title: The Hunger: The Story of the Irish Famine

overview: For the dedicated staff at the Toronto Wildlife Center, caring for an ill or injured animal and returning them to their natural habitat as soon as possible is its own reward. Watch as their amazing stories of compassion and triumph unfold.
title: City Wildlife Rescue

overview: Lu Ning'an, a young widow, toiled tirelessly for her deceased husband Xie Yunwang's family and helped her stepson Xie Zichen achieve success and fame. Yet, on her deathbed, she uncovered the shocking truth: Xie Yunwang had faked his death, his mistress Lin Wan'er flaunted her arrogance, and Xie Zichen's loyalty was a lie. Reborn into her past life, Lu Ning'an now wields unwavering resilience. She battles treacherous men, outsmarts scheming rivals, and dismantles the corrupt Xie family, forging a path of self-redemption and empowerment.
title: Reborn in Vengeance

overview: Cash Cab is a game show that aired on ITV in the United Kingdom from 13 June 2005 to 2006. The original programme that launched the worldwide Cash Cab franchise, it was hosted by John Moody. The questions were asked in voice over style by Annabel Raftery. The show's host initially poses as an ordinary taxi driver and drives around the major cities of the United Kingdom in a cab. The show pays its passengers for correctly answering standard general knowledge questions. Contestants are recruited in advance but are not told that the quiz will be taking place in the cab, so although the "pick-ups" are not as random as they appear on screen, the contestants are genuinely surprised when the taxi turns out to be the Cash Cab. (This differs from some editions, most notably the Canadian and American versions, wherein the contestants are generally chosen at random and are usually asked on camera if they wish to play or not once the rules are explained to them). The host of Cash Cab, John Moody, is a genuine qualified taxi driver.
title: Cash Cab

overview: Detective Renée Ballard is tasked with running the LAPD's new cold case division—a poorly funded, all-volunteer unit with the largest case load in the city. Ballard approaches these frozen-in-time cases with empathy and determination. When she uncovers a larger conspiracy during her investigations, she'll lean on the assistance of her retired ally, Harry Bosch, to navigate the dangers that threaten both her unit and her life.
title: Ballard

overview: The American Muscle Car series relives that incredible time when Detroit produced the most outrageous cars ever to hit the street.
title: American Muscle Car
Rent a Boss to Go Home for Chinese New Year

overview: A brilliant, never-married genius with seven doctoral degrees is transported to another world, where she gives birth to twins. She discovers she's the deposed Empress of Yan, and their father is the Emperor. Using her adorable children, she leads him into a desperate pursuit, making him regret everything.
title: Oops, I Gave Birth to the Emperor's Twins!

overview: Toutou and Zouzou live peacefully in their small house in the countryside, bickering occasionally. Toutou is a gardener, a patriarch, and a bit of a grump. Zouzou is a clever and sometimes mocking indoor cat, who knows how to make herself heard despite her very small voice. One morning, Toutou and Zouzou meet their new neighbour, Kiki. She's a flirtatious and curious frog who works in the weather forecast. The three of them will quickly become the best of friends!
title: La maison de Toutou

overview: From ancient times to the Second World War, Europe has been soaked in blood and intrigue. In this fascinating new series, Bloody Tales goes beyond the British Isles to seek out the Europe's most grisly history to discover the mysterious true stories behind some of history's most infamous tales. From East to West, from the UK to Istanbul, join historian Dr Suzannah Lipscomb and presenter Joe Crowley to investigate subjects that include Rome's famously cruel emperor Caligula and the notoriously violent Vikings. Using re-enactments, revisiting iconic locations and relying upon world-leading experts, can Suzannah and Joe sort fact from myth and rewrite some of history's greatest stories?
title: Bloody Tales of Europe
Feng Zhong You Duo Yu Zuo De Yun

overview: Black Girl in a Big Dress is a webseries series about an African American Anglophile cosplayer in love with the Victorian Era. Adrienne feels happy and confident when she's dressed up living life like it's a fairy tale, but back in the real world, it's a whole different story.
title: Black Girl in a Big Dress

overview: In the television series How to Survive...? we follow the coming of age of Rosa, and are witnessing her as she grows from an insecure twelve-year-old girl to a self-assured young adult. Rosa's life is by no means average and her friends offer her emails with survival tips on how to manage and overcome her problems.
title: Hoe overleef ik

overview: El jardinero tells the story of Elmer and his controlling mother, La China Jurado, who runs a garden centre that hides another thriving underground murder-for-hire business. Killing is easy for Elmer. An accident has left him emotionless. However, while planning the murder of Violet, a charming nursery school teacher, he falls in love with her. Elmer must learn to love while his mother does everything she can to end Violet's life.
title: El jardinero

overview: After getting released from prison, Sun is filled with anger and sets up an underground gang, the Bangkok Boys. While he expands his power searching for the truth behind the tragic deaths of his nearest and dearest, he falls in love with Peach, a sensitive Korean artist, and unknowingly sets himself up on a path of love and hatred intertwined. A bloodthirsty and heartbreaking urban revenge love story is about to unfold in Bangkok.
title: The Bangkok Boy

overview: Determined to avenge his dead brother, Brian goes undercover to exact his plan — but ends up falling for the ambitious cop on the case.
title: Escupiré sobre sus tumbas

overview: Polyfamily dives deep into the world of polyamory and non-traditional family structures. The show follows two married couples, Alysia & Tyler and Sean & Taya, who have chosen to live together as a closed quad. In this unconventional family set up, Tyler is dating Sean's wife, Taya, and Sean is dating Tyler's wife, Alysia. With four children already and another on the way, the quad is redefining what it means to be a family. A fascinating, vulnerable and unpredictable look at love, loyalty and the complexities of modern family life.
title: Polyfamily

overview: Lee Min Suk is just a normal high school hockey player - until he's forced to take his brother's place as the director for a major company. Now he's forced to balance school work, hockey practice, and making multi-million dollar decisions. No big deal?
title: King of High School Life Conduct

overview: High Hoops tells the story of a charmingly reckless high school basketball player and her chaotic pursuit of success, fame, love and the perfect hook shot. The show is about a failing school basketball team and the arrival of tall, gaffe-prone but unstoppable Aoife O'Neill. It's a show about determination, finding your tribe, and being true to yourself. Following Aoife and her family as they move to a new area and a new school. She sees this as an opportunity to change her life. Aoife soon discovers that the only place she really fits in is the school basketball team - only they're terrible. Can she turn them around?
title: High Hoops

overview: The wedding day turns into a nightmare for Chen Zi, the rich heiress, as her fiance betrays her. She goes to a bar to drink away her sorrows and gets into a fight with a thug. He Chuan comes to her rescue like a knight in shining armor. She is instantly smitten. When they cross paths again, she takes the initiative and proposes marriage. But she has no clue that this rugged mechanic has a secret life.
title: A Thousand Times for You

overview: Ráth Chairn is located in the southeast of the Boyne Valley, between Trim and Athboy in County Meath. This Gaeltacht area was founded in 1935, when a courageous group from Connemara moved east to create a better life for themselves. In this series, we will get an insight into what drives this vibrant and creative community, the aspects of life that are most important to them, and how they preserve their traditions in the beautiful Ráth Chairn.
title: Pobal Ráth Chairn

overview: Hosted by award-winning actor and comedian Andrew Phung, viewers can sink their teeth into this beefy competition that gives the beloved burger its moment in the spotlight with non-stop grilling action. Host Andrew Phung is joined on the judging panel by celebrated chef and restaurateur, Connie DeSousa,and author, Burger Scholar, and TV personality, George Motz. Each episode, the competitors unleash their creativity in three high-stakes challenges. The battle begins with the "Fast Food" challenge, where they must transform a mystery ingredient into a crave-worthy, burger-adjacent dish. Those with the judges' least favourite creations are sent to "Burgatory", forced to sit out the next round. Next up is "Burger Bucks", where a juicy $5,000 prize is up for grabs. Here, the remaining competitors craft an outside-the-box burger featuring a star ingredient that pushes culinary boundaries. Finally, in the "Big Burger Elimination" challenge, the chefs exiled to "Burgatory" return for a last shot at redemption. This time, they must create a stunning gourmet burger with a delectable side, knowing that one competitor will be sent home. Week after week, the pressure mounts until only three chefs remain. In the end, one champion will rise—grilling, smashing, and frying their way to victory to claim a $25,000 cash prize, an all-inclusive tropical vacation for two provided by Sunwing Vacations, and the coveted title of Big Burger Battle Champion!
title: Big Burger Battle

overview: The series, which draws from the comprehensive investigative reporting of Rolling Stone and the Toronto Star, charts the astonishing journey of Ryan Wedding – a former Olympic snowboarder who is now one of the FBI's Ten Most Wanted fugitives, accused of running a violent, billion-dollar drug empire for Mexico's most notorious cartel. The verité-driven documentary series takes viewers inside the hunt to uncover how Wedding transformed from national hero to alleged cartel boss and international fugitive. The Department of State is offering a reward of up to $10 million for information leading to the arrest and/or conviction of Wedding, who is wanted by the FBI for multiple charges, including orchestrating the murders of four people in Ontario, Canada. Since January, the team has been filming across Canada, Mexico, and the U.S., working alongside expert journalists and investigators - including Rolling Stone's Jesse Hyde, the Toronto Star's Calvi Leon and operatives in Mexico - as well as current and former FBI agents and law enforcement officials. Together, they trace Ryan Wedding's shocking transformation from Canadian snowboarding prodigy into alleged drug kingpin. As the hunt for Wedding escalates, SNOW KING incorporates firsthand accounts from the people whose lives have been irrevocably changed by the crimes he and his co-conspirators have been charged with, creating a visceral, story-driven portrait of the international drug trade – and its devastating human costs.
title: Snow King: From Olympian to Narco

overview: CNBC Sport: On the Record explores the convergence of sports, business, and investing. Each week, the biggest names in sports - from league commissioners, team owners, influential media executives and top athletes - will give an insider's perspective on the strategies, deals, and stories shaping sports and business.
title: CNBC Sport: On the Record

overview: Building on over 80 years of MLB chronicling the World Series, Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series takes fans deeper than ever before, offering a cinematic, all-access experience. Through exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, raw emotion, and high-stakes drama, the series expands the perspective on baseball's biggest stage, bringing audiences closer than ever to America's favorite pastime and the relentless pursuit of its ultimate prize. With unprecedented access to stars like Freddie Freeman, Mookie Betts, and Aaron Judge, the series captures the intensity of the game from the dugout to the clubhouse, offering a rare, unfiltered look at what it takes to compete at the highest level.
title: Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series

overview: Hustle is a series that follows a group of con artists who specialise in "long cons"—extended deceptions which require greater commitment, but which return a higher reward than simple confidence tricks.
title: Hustle

overview: Chinese Hong Kong averages 34 homicides per year, among which are sensational cases that have shocked the world. This drama presents multiple Chinese Hong Kong suspenseful mystery cases adapted from true events, including the Caesarean Baby Theft Case, the Doll Corpse Hidden Case, and more. The timeline of this drama unfolds sequentially across several cases, showcasing the process of solving each crime. Police Inspector Du Kaibin and female officer Yan Zhuoying become estranged due to a cold case. During an investigation into another unsolved case, the two reconcile their differences. Through repeated collaborations on various cases, their relationship grows into a bond of comradeship, fighting side by side. As their identities, mindsets, and life circumstances continuously evolve, the one thing that never changes is their unwavering determination to seek justice for the victims.
title: Case x Decoded

overview: Jon Culshaw stars in this satirical sketch show.
title: The Impressionable Jon Culshaw

overview: In the early 1980s, in the small town of Qingwu, the Qi and Cao families with vastly different family dynamics each welcome a new baby: Qi Shi and Cao Xin. Qi Shi, who suffers from albinism, is acutely aware of her difference from a young age, resorting to drinking soy sauce and wearing wigs in a desperate attempt to fit in. Meanwhile, Cao Xin is the quintessential perfect child in other parents' eyes—yet his reputation comes at the cost of his father's harsh demands. When the unconventional, brave, and stubborn girl crosses paths with the well-behaved, disciplined, and high-achieving boy, the two families—already close neighbors—find their lives intertwined through an absurd swapped-at-birth incident. This sparks a journey filled with tears and the chance for rebirth. As the younglings navigate the trials of family, friendship, and romance, the grown-ups grapple with their career, marriage, and family life. In the torrent of time filled with ups and downs, they heal and grow hand in hand, striving to find their calling and true happiness. "In My Prime" is a period family drama series adapted from Han Shisan's novel "Close Neighbors (Jin Lin)."
title: In My Prime

overview: The domineering CEO, Yi Ning, must marry in order to inherit her family business. Thus, she chooses a "supportive husband" — the charming private chef, Shen Qianze to start a contract marriage. Following their role reversal, Yi Ning finds herself falling for him. However, little does she know that Shen Qianze harbors a shocking secret. As he deliberately draws closer, she unknowingly surrenders to his love...
title: My Boyfriend

overview: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.
title: Blossoms of Power

overview: Xu Nuo, the pampered heiress of Yuanfei Group, returns home after studying abroad only to find her family in ruins: her mother cast out penniless, her adopted brother Shen Jiahe ready to seize her inheritance, and her father's fiancée turns out to be Bai Xia—her longtime rival and Shen's scandal-ridden ex. Seeing through Shen's schemes, Xu Nuo carefully plots her revenge, luring him into a high-stakes "Game of True Love," a dangerous dance between passion and rivalry.
title: Game of True Love

overview: Riyadh, 1970. Aziza reminisces about her youth as she, her sister Awatif, and the fierce Bedouin Wadha navigate battles of love, ambition, and defiance in a drastically shifting society.
title: Al-Ashi Street

overview: Each episode of this documentary series focuses on a different place of interest. One hundred cameras are installed and left to record, showcasing the habits and behavior of the people they capture. Without the presence of a camera crew, the subjects gradually begin to share glimpses into their lives, and we receive an unobstructed window into personal conversations and real-life events.
title: 100 Cameras

overview: This is a drama showing the attractiveness of analogue tools or devices. We show now and then.
title: Analogue Nostalgia

overview: Did you know that a lot of your favorite anime are based in real-life locations? Join us on a pilgrimage around Japan to the "Sanctuaries" that are the inspiration of some of the greatest anime!
title: Anime Sanctuaries

overview: What can artists do in time of war? This series conveys messages from Japanese artists in various fields in relation to war in the current world.
title: Artists Against War

overview: Japan's legendary martial arts―Budo. Their origins can be traced to the warrior traditions of the samurai. These martial arts have endured, existing in various forms to this day.
title: BUDO Secrets

overview: Digital Eye is an investigative journalism program making full use of geospatial and open source data to seek the truth behind important social issues. The program will use satellite images, social-media analysis and other advanced investigative tools to take an in-depth look at issues.
title: Digital Eye

overview: Trust No One is a high-stakes thriller about leadership, how lonely it gets at the top, and the death of privacy. The youngest-ever director of the most powerful intelligence agency in Israel, Itamar has forged a career recruiting and handling well-connected informants. Now Itamar is facing the crisis of his life: a cyber security leak is exposing the Israeli Security Agency's (ISA) top-secret agents one by one - starting with Shuruk, daughter of a Hamas leader who he recruited to spy on her own father when she was just 17 years old. Itamar turns to his protégé Yali, a cyber security genius who turned her back on the ISA. Recently released from prison, Yali agrees to help but quickly discovers she's being framed as the source of the leaks. As the leaks continue and more lives are threatened, Itamar does everything to protect his exposed operatives in a race against time. As they close in on the truth together, Itamar's family becomes entangled, forcing him to choose between them, the lives of his operatives, and the career he loves.
title: Trust No One

overview: Keep watching Debut's Plan and SAVE your favorite NewKids to reach the final debut evaluation.
title: Debut's Plan

overview: In 1790 Johan Gustav Dåådh joins the Stockholm police, in an attempt to change, or at least improve, the system from within. He is a modern thinker in an old hierarchy. Torn between alliances, he solves crimes among rich and poor.
title: Anno 1790

overview: There are 9 characters in the program, each with a bright personality. They all go out into the city to carry out their special mission. They provoke, argue, misbehave... In general, they use all possible means to bring out various emotions in unsuspecting people on the street. At this time, a hidden camera is watching them - the resulting stories are watched in the studio by viewers, the host of the show Dominic Joker and a jury consisting of three show business stars. The author and participant of the most reckless story becomes the winner, he is awarded a prize - an Oscar statuette without brains.
title: Без башни

overview: Documentary project by Margarita Simonyan "Ch.T.D." On the eve of the 80th anniversary of the Victory in the Great Patriotic War, the author and presenter will talk about the events of that terrible war through the prism of individual historical figures. For example, Margarita will tell about the fate and history of the legendary pilot Alexei Maresyev, the famous front-line correspondent and writer Boris Polevoy, how the famous female bomber aviation regiment "Night Witches" was formed and operated during the war, as well as how the main song of the war years, "Sacred War," was written, how one of the most famous underground anti-fascist organizations was created, consisting of young people, yesterday's schoolchildren, who became the prototype for the "Soldier-Liberator" monument in Treptower Park and much more. Each episode of the documentary project will use quotes from films, books and documents, biographies and memoirs of participants in the events.
title: Ч.Т.Д. с Маргаритой Симоньян

overview: 100 великих is the first documentary series about all the legacies of humanity: from Gagarin's speech to the invention of the wheel, from the statue of David to gene technology, from Maradona's goal to the battle for Sevastopol. Everything that has changed and continues to change our lives, watch in the series "100 Greats".
title: 100 великих

overview: In 1995, an ambitious young recruit in an anti-terrorism unit is sent to Peranne to investigate the killing of an imam alongside Jean, a disillusioned gendarme haunted by his memories of the Algerian War.
title: Cimetière indien

overview: Diego, a Mossad agent whose sister was killed in the Argentina terrorist attack, takes a leave of absence and hooks up with Gisela, a local journalist to find those responsible. Their journey to uncover the truth draws them into a world of espionage, intelligence agencies and arms dealers. A dubious world in which lies are truths, and justice and revenge become indistinguishable. The journey that the two embark on will eventually lead to a re-examination of their connection with their families and even their concept of self-identity.
title: The goal AMIA

overview: A police sergeant in Oslo accidently kills his horse in front of a crowd children during a parade. As a result, he is posted to a remote town in southern Norway with a population of eccentric citizens.
title: Hellfjord

overview: The "Azure-1" project, a globally high-profile scientific research, becomes the target of sabotage by the foreign spy agency SAD. Shura controlled by Gapung seeks to steal the project's core technology. National security officer Huo Min and his team foil the plot planned by SAD, see through Shura's infiltration strategy, and ultimately bright the moles and spies to justice.
title: Secret Files of XSA

overview: The Westies takes place during the construction of the Jacob Javitz Convention Center on the Westies' home turf in Hell's Kitchen, which promises a financial windfall. Despite being outnumbered fifty-to-one by the Five Families of the Italian Mafia, the Westies' legendary brutality and cunning have given them the leverage necessary to share the spoils through a fragile détente. But internal conflict between the brash younger generation and the old-school leadership threatens to set a match to this powder keg, which will sweep the Westies into the FBI's ever-deepening investigation into the Italian mafia.
title: The Westies

overview: Private investigators Matt Shade and Angie Everett have left behind their P.I. firm and settled into a new life on the west coast — but their new quiet life is shaken when a night out lands them at the scene of a murder. A woman stands over her dead boyfriend with a bloody steak knife in hand. Believing in her innocence, Shade and Angie dive headfirst back into the high stakes world of investigation. The private eyes juggle the challenges of opening a P.I. firm in a new city, and without their friendly Toronto network of sources, Shade and Angie work to build a new community. From tracking down a missing student in the wilderness of British Columbia to extracting a murder confession from a surfer in Tofino, Shade and Angie prove life on the west coast is packed with heart-pounding thrills.
title: Private Eyes West Coast

overview: Madrid 1920s, Marquise Elena de Valmonte explores her passion for cooking, as a means for evading her authoritarian husband. An incident makes her and maid Cecilia fugitives. They reopen an abandoned restaurant as 'La Favorita Bistro'.
title: La Favorita 1922

overview: Fresh graduate Yooha struggles to find a job and takes on gig work to become independent. Meanwhile, workaholic Minwoo, tired of marriage pressure, hires a fake boyfriend for a month. Yooha, exhausted from difficult clients, accepts Minwoo's high-paying offer—with three simple rules: secrecy, two meetings per week, and answering calls when needed. Their contract is clear, but as they continue the act, pretend feelings start to feel real.
title: Sweetheart Service

overview: The strangest unexplained mysteries ever discovered. Including footage of UFO's, mysterious anomalies, paranormal sightings, strange discoveries in space and bizarre case files. An incredible library of rare stories and sightings caught on video.
title: The World's Strangest Mysteries

overview: This new series provides a rare look into two of Scotland's prisons which house women - HMP and YOI Grampian in Peterhead which has 50 prisoners and HMP & YOI Stirling which operates with up to 117 prisoners With wide access to both prisons which offers insights into daily prison life, work assignments, and family visits, Jailed: Women in Prison hears from both prisoners and staff and presents the day-to-day realities of life behind bars.
title: Jailed: Women in Prison

overview: Delving deep into the social history of Scottish fashion, from Selkirk to Shetland, Icons of Style sees Kirsty Wark explore how Scotland made a big impact on the global fashion scene. Along the way, Kirsty meets the iconic designers, influencers and celebrities who brought catwalk style to international notoriety and championed the country's unique sense of style. Reflecting on 60 years of Scottish fashion and an enduring influence on the world's fashion stage Kirsty Wark meets the Scots who shaped the industry through the decades and highlights its enduring appeal.
title: Icons of Style

overview: Global conspiracies, secret research, forbidden predictions and technologies of the future - in special half-hour digest projects from the most knowledgeable presenters of the TV channel. Who wants to feed humanity with mutant meat and oil cabbage? How not to "get hooked" on the cult of consumption? Where do financial pyramids come from in social networks - and is there salvation from them? What is the danger of ... hygiene? How great is the power of hypnosis? How much would car dealership customers save if they paid only for what they really need? What rights does Turkey claim to Antarctica? And when will mushrooms and deep-sea monsters take over the planet?
title: День секретных проектов

overview: "Deal?!" is not only a gambling and surefire game - the player will not return home empty-handed in any case. But also a bright, spectacular, truly exciting show. The growing suspense, the maximum intensity of passions are akin to the emotions of sports fans! TV viewers are involved in the gameplay, from which they can no longer tear themselves away. Not only playing, but also watching the game is an unforgettable pleasure! The project has gained extraordinary popularity not only in its homeland in the UK, but has also won the hearts of millions of TV viewers around the world. The program is watched in 37 countries, including the Middle East and South America. And everywhere this show shows consistently high ratings. "Deal?!" is a licensed format adapted by the REN TV channel together with the ENDEMOL company (Russia) for Russian TV viewers.
title: Сделка?!

overview: In the show, anyone can earn 3 million by opening suitcases
title: Пан или пропал

overview: The events take place at the beginning of the last century, when the revolution had already occurred in Russia, and in bourgeois Latvia it was just beginning. The members of the simple peasant family of the Zithars had a difficult choice: to go with the revolutionaries or to come to terms with the orders of the bourgeois republic.
title: Семья Зитаров

overview: When a neighbor's au pair vanishes from her wealthy suburb, Cecilie seeks answers — and unravels secrets that shatter her seemingly perfect world.
title: Reservatet

overview: In 2003, rock singer Bertrand Cantat killed his partner, actress Marie Trintignant. This documentary revisits the case that divided a nation.
title: De rockstar à tueur: le cas Cantat

overview: After losing his job, his marriage, and an unbreakable bond with his only daughter, Saleh sees online gambling as his ticket to redemption. But his final bet leads him down a dangerous path that changes his life forever.
title: Expired

overview: The sovereign Greek island of Ithaca, 8th century B.C. The Trojan War has been over for ten years, and the Greeks have come home victorious. Only one man is missing: the king of Ithaca, Odysseus, who is lost at sea. The island's economy is getting worse by the day as the region's many princes have invaded the kingdom, devouring its resources, and pressuring Queen Penelope to choose a new husband. To delay her suitors, she promises to choose once she's finished weaving King Laertes' burial shroud. But she undoes her work every night. Odysseus' son Telemachus doesn't dare lay claim to his father's throne. His only dream is to sail out to rescue Odysseus. Everything accelerates when a travelling musician awakens Penelope's buried feelings. Who will become King? The manipulator Leocrites? The true heir Telemachus? Or the seductive traveller Eukharistos? Or will Odysseus make...
title: Odysseus

overview: Katerina Lavinskaya is the embodiment of a successful and happy life. Owner of a fashionable art gallery, style icon, wife of a famous businessman, expectant mother… It seems that nothing mars this woman's carefree existence, but even those closest to her are unaware that Katerina's past conceals a terrible and dark secret that could destroy her entire life at any moment.
title: Потерянная жизнь

overview: The Lady charts the rise and fall of former royal dresser Jane Andrews, whose rags to riches fairy tale fell apart when she was convicted of murder. Once a young working-class girl from Grimsby, Jane answered an advertisement in the magazine The Lady and to the astonishment of her friends and family, became the Duchess of York's dresser at Buckingham Palace. Moving amongst the highest social circles in Britain, Jane managed to secure a place in the upper-classes, only to lose her job with the Duchess after nine years of service. Still reeling from her fall from grace, Jane went on to meet charismatic businessman Thomas Cressman and fell deeply in love. Soon cracks began to develop in the romance Jane had pinned all her hopes on, with disastrous consequences.
title: The Lady

overview: This drama follows modern-day woman Chu Ci and the time-traveling poet sage Du Fu on a dreamlike journey. Bound together by fate after an accidental fall into the water, Chu Ci must wait for Du Fu to return to the past before she can regain her freedom. From exploring Chengdu and revisiting the Thatched Cottage to visiting Wuhou Shrine and ascending Mount Emei, their travels lead to a deepening friendship. Along the way, their perspectives on society and life quietly evolve. Through their relentless trials as fated companions, Chu Ci rediscovers her path in life, while Du Fu finds resolution and uncovers his own boundless world and greater truth.
title: Roaming China with Tang Poetry

overview: The Ning Dynasty is on the brink. Pei Shenzhi tampers with the testamentary edict and installs Ning Jinyi as a puppet emperor. Ning Jinyi feigns compliance while secretly amassing strength and launching new policies. Pei Shenzhi, drawn to her wit, supports her covertly. Ultimately, she purges the court and rises to be a great empress.
title: Dominion and Devotion
